title: Embeddable capacity + support experiments for air-gapped / VPC packages
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and run pricing & contract experiments for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers that evaluates a split commercial model: base platform license + capacity units (GPU-equivalent) + optional premium support/upgrade cadence. Produce a standard security questionnaire response pack and a set of contract clauses for upgrade windows, maintenance windows, and air-gap patching SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment plan with three pricing variants (flat license + capacity units, all-in-one tiered license, and usage-only with support add-on) documented
Contract clause templates for upgrade cadence (quarterly, semi-annual, annual) and emergency patch SLA reviewed by Legal
Security questionnaire canonical answers and an attachable artifacts pack (SOC2 summary, KMS support, network topology guidance) assembled
Pilot quotes prepared for 3 customers representing mid-market, enterprise, and regulated industry personas
Metrics tracked: conversion rate from proof-of-concept to paid, ARR per seat/GPU-equivalent, churn risk flagged in 90-day window
